<div class="pvme-exact-guide">

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Combat is a key pillar of the game and can be overwhelming at times - it need not be this way! The aim of this channel is to help you get up and running with some ideas on how to train your levels whilst being fully immersed into the world of RuneScape.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>We will cover in this channel:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Some key tips before you start</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Early game combat quests to help you gain some levels whilst being immersed in the lore</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Some training suggestions (these are not mandatory)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ An introduction to War's Retreat and some further quest information relating to combat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="some-key-tips-before-you-start"><ins><nowiki>Some key tips before you start</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Hit chance i.e. your damage scaling when attacking monsters can be viewed as a percentage on the monster's HP bar. The higher the number, the greater your damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Wearing &quot;off-style&quot; armour e.g. a melee weapon with magic armour severely impacts your hit chance in a negative manner! Be sure to match your armour combat style with your weapon combat style.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> affects melee accuracy and its level is what determines what melee weapons you can equip. Strength </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> determines your damage dealt with melee weapons.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The best defence is a good offence: weapon upgrades take precedence over armour upgrades!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You will level quickly in the early levels - if you feel like you can survive without issues, skip an armour upgrade and save your gold for the following one</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When using Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you should regularly upgrade your auto-cast to the highest available spell tier. You can find out a spell's damage level cap by checking its tooltip.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>For example: Air strike's damage cap is at level 16 - you can upgrade to Air bolt at level 17.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you need help, don't struggle in silence! You can ask questions in the help channels of:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The official Runescape Discord </nowiki>[https://discord.com/invite/rs <nowiki>invite link</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><span><nowiki>#affiliates</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The PvM Encyclopedia </nowiki>[https://discord.gg/invite/pvme <nowiki>invite link</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="early-combat"><ins><nowiki>Early Combat</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="quests-can-be-a-great-way-to-get-the-early-levels-in-any-skill-including-combat-skills"><nowiki>Quests can be a great way to get the early levels in any skill, including combat </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> skills</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Some initial quests we highly recommend are the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ These set you up to more easily manage other early quest fights:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Waterfall_Quest <nowiki>Waterfall quest</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Merlin%27s_Crystal <nowiki>Merlin's crystal</nowiki>]<nowiki> → </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Holy_Grail <nowiki>Holy grail</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy! <nowiki>Necromancy! (tutorial quest)</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Gather 400 souls to lvl20; fragile mementos are recommended</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At level 20 &amp; 24: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Kili_Row <nowiki>Kili row</nowiki>]<nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Rune_Mythos <nowiki>Rune Mythos</nowiki>]<nowiki> quests</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ These quests require fighting and introduce you to combat - you'll be rewarded for your efforts with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> xp:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎</nowiki><em><nowiki>(the skill icons indicate where we think you should spend that xp)</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Vampyre_Slayer <nowiki>Vampyre Slayer</nowiki>]<nowiki> - Use the xp reward on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Witch's_House <nowiki>Witch's House</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Fight_Arena <nowiki>Fight Arena</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864807920250900.png?v=1" alt="thieving" title="thieving" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use Halberd or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to safespot the boss fight</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Grand_Tree/Quick_guide <nowiki>Grand Tree</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> lamp</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use Halberd or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to safespot the boss fight</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Tree_Gnome_Village <nowiki>Tree gnome village</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The quest and miniquest below offer a reward which will greatly enhance your damage against undead creatures:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎</nowiki><em><nowiki>(we recommend having level 50 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> skills and gear)</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Haunted_Mine <nowiki>Haunted Mine</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Lair_of_Tarn_Razorlor_(miniquest) <nowiki>Miniquest: Lair of Tarn Razorlor</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Yields: salve amulet(e) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: This amulet gives +20% accuracy and damage against </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) <nowiki>Undead</nowiki>]<nowiki> creatures</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The quest below unlocks the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_Magicks <nowiki>ancient spellbook</nowiki>]<nowiki> and therefore </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Vampyrism <nowiki>Vampyrism</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismaspect" title="vampyrismaspect" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, providing a powerful early sustain unlock:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Desert_Treasure <nowiki>Desert Treasure</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Also requires level 69 magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to cast, which can be boosted using potions</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="combat-training"><ins><nowiki>Combat </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Training</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If questing isn't your cup of tea - getting stuck into killing some monsters might be more your style:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Combat levelling focuses on killing monsters for xp</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upgrade your weapons to a higher tier when you can!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Include area-of-effect (AoE) abilities as they become available. Check ability tooltips.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Chinchompa <nowiki>chinchompas</nowiki>]<nowiki> turn non-AoE abilities into AoE attacks within 1 tile of the target</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Halberd <nowiki>halberds</nowiki>]<nowiki> gives a longer range on AoE attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_Magicks <nowiki>ancient spellbook</nowiki>]<nowiki> gives AoE basic attacks, but requires the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Desert_Treasure <nowiki>Desert Treasure</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: AoE tools are largely locked behind levels and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Well_of_Souls <nowiki>Well of Souls</nowiki>]<nowiki> upgrades</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>We also have some pre-created ability bars and gear progression suggestions to help you slay these monsters. You can check them out here:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Early </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> upgrade order &amp; ability bars:</nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Early </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> upgrade order &amp; ability bars: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Early </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> upgrade order &amp; ability bars: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Early </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> upgrade order, talent tree &amp; ability bars:</nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="some-methods-you-can-try-out"><nowiki>Some methods you can try out:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Level 1-30:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ghostly_troll_bruiser <nowiki>Ghostly Trolls</nowiki>]<nowiki> in City of Um cave</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Monsters in </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Lumbridge_Catacombs#Monsters <nowiki>Lumbridge Catacombs</nowiki>]<nowiki> (req. </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact/Quick_guide <nowiki>Blood Pact</nowiki>]<nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Trolls in the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Burthorpe_Troll_Cave <nowiki>Burthorpe Troll Cave</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Level 30-50/60:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Bandit_(Kharidian_Desert_Bandit_Camp) <nowiki>Bandits</nowiki>]<nowiki> in the Bandit Camp bar</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Wear any piece of Saradomin or Zamorak equipment to make them continuously aggressive</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Fetid_zombie <nowiki>Fetid Zombies</nowiki>]<nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> works)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sanguine_crawler <nowiki>Sanguine Crawlers</nowiki>]<nowiki> using upgraded </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Havensilver_weapons <nowiki>Havensilver weapons</nowiki>]<nowiki> (req. </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Visions_of_Havenhythe <nowiki>Visions of Havenhythe</nowiki>]<nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Level 50/60-80:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyss/Combat_training <nowiki>The Abyss Monsters</nowiki>]<nowiki> (req. </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Enter_the_Abyss_(miniquest)/Quick_guide <nowiki>Enter the Abyss miniquest</nowiki>]<nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Bound_skeleton <nowiki>Bound Skeletons</nowiki>]<nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> works)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Flesh-hatcher_Mhekarnahz <nowiki>Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Boss, recommended to start from level 60 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or level 70 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>At any point you may also opt to try </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_assignment <nowiki>Slayer Assignments</nowiki>]<nowiki> for the sake of variety or to familiarise yourself with different monsters throughout the game world</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="wars-retreat-bossing"><ins><nowiki>War's Retreat &amp; Bossing</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/War%27s_Retreat <nowiki>War's Retreat</nowiki>]<nowiki> is a PvM hub that can be accessed at </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Level 60 or with a Total Level of 1000 north of Draynor lodestone</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This place can serve as a free, unlimited place to teleport to for easy bank access, restoring prayer and more as you increase your boss kill count</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To unlock the teleport, it is recommended to kill 10 lower level bosses such as </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ivar,_King_of_Bones <nowiki>Ivar, King of Bones</nowiki>]<nowiki>, </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/King_Black_Dragon <nowiki>King Black Dragon</nowiki>]<nowiki>, or </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Giant_mole <nowiki>Giant Mole</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For more info on bossing see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#bossing-path</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Reaper <nowiki>Reaper tasks</nowiki>]<nowiki> are a PvM activity that can be accessed at </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Level 50 with 45 Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> by talking to Death, north of Draynor lodestone</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You earn Reaper points </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/704657943194501140.png?v=1" alt="reaperpoints" title="reaperpoints" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to spend on rewards by killing bosses in a quantity that Death assigns you. You will only be given bosses that you have the levels/unlocks to access.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will also gain Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> experience for completing the task</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="quests"><ins><nowiki>Quests</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For a list of quests with useful PvM unlocks, see </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Quest Unlocks</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#permanent-unlocks</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ One of the first useful unlocks to aim for is the tier 3 </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box <nowiki>Infernal Puzzle Box</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, which prevents your adrenaline from draining when outside of combat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can find the box in </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Zamorakian_Undercity#Getting_there <nowiki>The Zamorakian Undercity</nowiki>]<nowiki> specifically </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box#mapFullscreen <nowiki>here</nowiki>]<nowiki>. Completing the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Daughter_of_Chaos/Quick_guide <nowiki>Daughter of Chaos</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest (40 Archaeology </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and 40 Divination </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1042453694735712286.png?v=1" alt="divination" title="divination" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) unlocks tier 2.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To unlock tier 3, complete the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Civil_War_I_(miniquest)/Quick_guide <nowiki>Civil War I</nowiki>]<nowiki> miniquest, and the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Gross_Misconduct <nowiki>Gross Misconduct achievement</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Two quests also worth mentioning are </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Temple_at_Senntisten/Quick_guide <nowiki>The Temple at Senntisten</nowiki>]<nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End/Quick_guide <nowiki>Plague's End</nowiki>]<nowiki>. The first unlocks curses, which are basically stronger prayers. The second unlocks better overloads and combination potions.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Note that quests are more rewarding the sooner you do them, due to how level XP scaling works</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
